full_judgment: 9. Mr. Probir Neogi, the learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the pre-emptor-respondent No.1 submits that the respondent is a co-sharer tenant by Ewaznama (Exchange Deed) dated 04.01.1988 and he is also a co-sharer by purchase from the father of the appellant. As such he submits that the High Court Division did not commit any illegality in passing the impugned judgment which is based on proper appreciation of section 96 as well as section 10 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. Hence he submits that this appeal should be dismissed.
